job.education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
job.summary: We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines for a retail analytics platform. The role requires at least 5 years of experience, strong Python and SQL skills, and proficiency in Apache Spark, Airflow, and AWS. Responsibilities include optimizing Spark jobs, implementing data quality checks, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating with analysts.

structured_cv.headline: Senior Data Engineer

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
highlights: Built PySpark pipelines on AWS EMR processing 4 TB/day
Introduced dbt models and Great Expectations data-quality checks

experience.title: Data Engineer
highlights: Python and SQL ETL into S3 and Glue

structured_cv.summary: Priya Sharma is a Senior Data Engineer with 7 years of experience building data platforms for e-commerce and retail. She has extensive expertise in developing PySpark pipelines on AWS, orchestrating workflows with Apache Airflow, migrating data warehouses to Redshift, and implementing dbt models and streaming ingestion with Kafka. Priya holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi and has a proven track record of mentoring junior engineers and ensuring data quality.

strengths: Exceeds experience requirement with 7 years of hands-on data engineering experience.
Comprehensive coverage of cloud data services on AWS (EMR, Glue, Redshift, S3) and orchestration with Airflow.
Direct retail and e-commerce domain experience from ShopMart.
Evidenced leadership in mentoring junior engineers and establishing data quality checks with Great Expectations.
risks: Apache Spark is evidenced primarily through PySpark rather than standalone core Spark/Scala experience.
ranked_candidates.explanation: Priya Sharma is an exceptional match for the Senior Data Engineer role, surpassing the required 5 years of experience with 7 years of specialized background. She holds an aligned B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi, satisfying the education criteria completely. Her technical expertise covers almost every must-have skill, including Python, SQL, PySpark, Airflow, and the complete AWS analytical stack. Although standalone 'Apache Spark' was not explicitly itemized, her experience scaling 4 TB/day pipelines on EMR demonstrates production-level Spark mastery. She also brings desired nice-to-have skills such as Kafka, dbt, Docker, and Terraform. In addition, her background at ShopMart directly fulfills the retail and e-commerce analytics domain focus while covering key responsibilities like mentoring and data quality management.
ranked_candidates.calibration_note: Clear top candidate exceeding experience requirements with 7 years of specialized data engineering and strong technical alignment.

experience.title: Data Engineer

scheduling with cron and AWS Step Functions

structured_cv.summary: Rahul Verma is a Data Engineer with 5 years of experience specializing in building data pipelines, batch processing, and cloud analytics. He has worked at FinServe Ltd and Analytics Hub, utilizing technologies such as Python, Apache Spark, SQL, AWS, Redshift, and Docker. His technical background includes developing Spark batch jobs on AWS EMR, managing SQL transformations in Redshift, and automating workflows using cron and AWS Step Functions. He holds a B.E. in Information Technology.

strengths: Meets the 5-year experience requirement across core data engineering responsibilities.
Solid technical foundation in Python, SQL, Spark batch processing, and Redshift on AWS.
Strong educational background with a B.E. in Information Technology.
risks: Lacks experience with Apache Airflow, relying instead on basic cron and Step Functions.
No demonstrated background in retail or e-commerce domains, coming primarily from financial services.
Missing explicit coverage of streaming technologies (Kafka) and key AWS tools like Glue and S3.
Limited evidence of senior-level duties such as mentoring junior engineers or architectural ownership.
ranked_candidates.explanation: Rahul Verma meets the baseline experience requirement with 5 years of data engineering work, primarily focused on batch data processing and SQL transformations. His core technical stack aligns with foundational needs, including Python, Apache Spark, Redshift, and AWS EMR. However, he lacks direct experience with key job requirements such as Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, and S3 data lake patterns. His professional experience is in financial services rather than the preferred retail analytics domain, and there is no evidence of real-time streaming pipeline development. Additionally, his resume shows mid-level individual contributor work without demonstrable senior ownership or mentorship responsibilities. He represents a competent mid-level data engineer who would require ramp-up to operate effectively at the Senior level for this role.
ranked_candidates.calibration_note: Solid second choice meeting the 5-year experience requirement with hands-on batch DE experience, despite gaps in Airflow and AWS Glue.

Her technical skill set includes SQL, Python, pandas, Tableau, Excel, and Snowflake. She holds a B.Sc. in Statistics.

strengths: Direct industry exposure to retail merchandising analytics at RetailCo
Demonstrated foundational proficiency in SQL, Python, and data warehouse querying via Snowflake
Relevant quantitative degree with a B.Sc. in Statistics
risks: Significantly underqualified on seniority, holding 3 years of data analysis experience against the 5+ years required for a senior engineering post
Lacks 8 out of 10 must-have data engineering technologies, including Spark, Airflow, and the AWS ecosystem
No proven experience architecting scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, managing distributed compute, or mentoring junior staff
ranked_candidates.explanation: Emily Chen presents a profile that does not align with the requirements for a Senior Data Engineer. While she brings three years of experience at RetailCo working on retail analytics, her background is firmly rooted in data analysis and business intelligence reporting rather than data engineering. She matches only two core skills, Python and SQL, while missing fundamental pipeline technologies including Spark, Airflow, and AWS services. Furthermore, she does not meet the minimum requirement of five years of experience, lacking exposure to large-scale data architecture and team mentorship. Her degree in Statistics provides a strong quantitative base, but it cannot bridge the technical engineering gaps. Overall, she is not qualified for this senior-level role.
ranked_candidates.calibration_note: Junior/adjacent candidate with 3 years in data analytics/BI and verified Python/SQL skills, though lacking distributed computing and pipeline tools.
